notes.title: Hotfix for Build 8130
notes.notes:
🐞

  Volleyball score calculation
  Information about the client kicking the ball now displays the name of both the player and the guest player
  It was not possible to create a Coop Session for the second time
  A custom session was not created if a session with the same name already existed
  Fixed the Result match for noprime matchmaking if the host turned off the server or connectivity was lost
  Joining a party was not possible if the search had been previously started and then turned off
  The client could not see their own name for the coop tournament
  Inviting a player to the coop tournament
  Camera overlap issue
  Locking the camera onto the ball was not possible during a sprint
  Update coop session settings
  Locking the session for coop when the game starts


⚽

  Added new customization
  UI loading information
